title: BRIDGING THE LLM ACCESSIBILITY DIVIDE? PERFORMANCE, FAIRNESS, AND COST OF CLOSED VERSUS OPEN LLMS FOR AUTOMATED ESSAY SCORING

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the LLM essay scoring error rates (the difference between the human ground-truth score and the LLM's predicted score) across binarized age groups (Young: 25 and below vs. Old: 26 and above) using ANOVA models.
